svg.text: An agent with a cortex and a hippocampus
Six layers. Each has one input type and one output type. Only L2 holds state; only L3 writes head weights and rules; the voice holds no memory at all.
Stimulus
photo · clip · text · sound
L0 · SENSES
TRIBE v2 on Modal: 20,484-vertex cortex at 1 Hz → 360 cortical area features
pure function, cached by content hash · image, video, audio and text pathways
L1 · ORGANS
Calibrated heads on area features: five crowd heads + your personal head
pure given their weights · every score is a weighted sum of named cortical areas, so "why" is a back-projection
L2 · ENGRAM STORE · the only state
One row per percept: cortex vector, 1 Hz time course, stimulus, outcomes, surprise, note
SQLite, inspectable · recall = cosine in cortex space ("what felt like this?") · contrast(A, B) · drift(you vs crowd)
L3 · SLEEP · the only writer
Prioritized replay → refit the personal head → mine rules
area contrasts with bootstrap CIs, written as falsifiable English into a ledger
(retired, never edited) · runs after every 10 outcomes · CPU, seconds
L4 · CORTEX IN THE LOOP
Anything the agent makes is read by L0–L1 before it is shown
critique → art direction → revision · pages, ads, rooms, writing
gated by facts, density and a blind judge
L5 · VOICE + ROUTER · Muse Spark
Picks the sense and the heads, speaks as the brain, holds no memory
reads L2 through tools · reflex: precedent ≥ 0.9 + confident personal head + rule → one sentence, no reasoning pass
